# Uniting to Save and Sustain Lives

## Redefining Healthcare Delivery

We are everywhere healthcare happens – and everywhere it is going, with essential solutions in the
hospital, physician’s office and other sites of care. Every day, millions of patients and healthcare
providers rely on our unmatched portfolio of connected solutions, medical devices, and advanced
injectable technologies to help deliver smarter, more personalized care. Together, we are redefining
how care is delivered to make a greater impact today, tomorrow, and beyond.

[Nurse holding a mobile device]

## The future of healthcare is connected

Healthcare is at a turning point. Clinicians face growing workloads, while patients increasingly
expect seamless, coordinated experiences. Despite recent advances in technology, medical devices and
clinical systems continue to be isolated from each other, preventing effective data sharing,
creating inefficiencies and increasing the potential for gaps in care. The future demands better
connectivity.
* **100,000** nurses left the workforce during the COVID-19 pandemic
* **610,338** nurses reported intent to leave by 2027

[See how we’re connecting care][52]

the infusion pumps that delivered her chemotherapy.

## Our Commitment to Healthcare Professionals and Patients

We are committed to supporting patients and healthcare professionals with innovations that are
driven by compassion for their journeys, a passion to improve care and the ambition to transform the
future of healthcare.

[A doctor in a hospital room looks off to the side]

### Primary Care [ Primary Care Go to Primary Care ][71]

Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
vitals monitoring and vision screening

workflows

home

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][79]

Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve mobility

### Our Products [ Our Products Go to Our Products ][81]

Enabling clinicians to treat patients more efficiently and effectively across care settings,
including in the office-based practice, inpatient care, outpatient care and at home

[ Go to Our Products ][82]
[Two ladies have a discussion in a coffee shop]

## For Patients

You are our passion. Your stories inspire us to work harder at bringing innovations that can make
your experience easier, speed recovery and enable the best possible quality of life.

[Discover Patient Stories][83]

### More For Patients

### General Healthcare [ General Healthcare Go to General Healthcare ][84]

Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
support every step of your journey.

[ Go to General Healthcare ][85]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][86]

When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide clinical nutrition
options to help you regain your nutritional status.

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][87]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][88]

We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven respiratory
therapy in the hospital and at home.

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][89]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

[Learn More About Our Leadership][90]

### Our Corporate Responsibility

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

[Learn More About Our Corporate Responsibility][91]

### Careers

This is where an inclusive community of diverse individuals is driven to go beyond what is, to what
is possible in healthcare.

[Learn More About Careers at Baxter][92]

### Our History

For more than 90 years, we’ve been focused on our commitment to save and sustain lives with
innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

[Learn More About Our History][93]

### Baxter Showcases Recent Innovations at AORN Global Surgical Conference and Expo 2026

## Our Commitment to Healthcare Professionals and Patients

We are committed to supporting patients and healthcare professionals with innovations that are
driven by compassion for their journeys, a passion to improve care and the ambition to transform the
future of healthcare.

[A doctor in a hospital room looks off to the side]

## Products for Healthcare Professionals

### Primary Care [ Primary Care Go to Primary Care ][71]

Supporting every aspect of your clinical practice, including physical exam, diagnostic cardiology,
vitals monitoring and vision screening

[ Go to Primary Care ][72]

### Hospital Care [ Hospital Care Go to Hospital Care ][73]

Advancing products and technologies designed to speed patient recovery and streamline clinical
workflows

[ Go to Hospital Care ][74]

### Surgical Care [ Surgical Care Go to Surgical Care ][75]

Delivering innovations that enable reduced operating times, faster patient recovery and improved
outcomes

[ Go to Surgical Care ][76]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][77]

Personalizing nutritional care designed to improve patients’ health in the hospital, the ICU and at
home

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][78]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][79]

Helping your patients with respiratory therapies designed to simplify delivery and improve mobility

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][80]

### Our Products [ Our Products Go to Our Products ][81]

Enabling clinicians to treat patients more efficiently and effectively across care settings,
including in the office-based practice, inpatient care, outpatient care and at home

[ Go to Our Products ][82]
[Two ladies have a discussion in a coffee shop]

## For Patients

You are our passion. Your stories inspire us to work harder at bringing innovations that can make
your experience easier, speed recovery and enable the best possible quality of life.

[Discover Patient Stories][83]

### More For Patients

### General Healthcare [ General Healthcare Go to General Healthcare ][84]

Whether you are receiving care in the hospital, at your doctor’s office or at home, we are here to
support every step of your journey.

[ Go to General Healthcare ][85]

### Nutritional Care [ Nutritional Care Go to Nutritional Care ][86]

When medical conditions prevent you from adequately feeding yourself, we provide clinical nutrition
options to help you regain your nutritional status.

[ Go to Nutritional Care ][87]

### Respiratory Care [ Respiratory Care Go to Respiratory Care ][88]

We are committed to helping you with innovative products that deliver effective, proven respiratory
therapy in the hospital and at home.

[ Go to Respiratory Care ][89]

## Bringing our Purpose to Life

Our mission to save and sustain lives is reflected in our business priorities and our commitment to
be an agent of change at a global level. This means doing what is right for our planet, our patients
and customers, our teams and our communities. We put this commitment into action through high-impact
philanthropy, diversity, equity and inclusion, nurturing partnerships with the healthcare community
and striving for the highest standards of corporate responsibility.

### Our Leadership

Our forward-looking leadership team is a driving force in ensuring we meet our commitments – every
day and everywhere.

[Learn More About Our Leadership][90]

### Our Corporate Responsibility

For nearly a century, we have made a meaningful difference in global healthcare while creating
lasting value for the communities we serve.

[Learn More About Our Corporate Responsibility][91]

### Careers

This is where an inclusive community of diverse individuals is driven to go beyond what is, to what
is possible in healthcare.

[Learn More About Careers at Baxter][92]

### Our History

For more than 90 years, we’ve been focused on our commitment to save and sustain lives with
innovations that elevate patient care, improve outcomes and drive healthcare transformation.

[Learn More About Our History][93]

## Celerion’s commitment to swift, exceptional research through translational medicine.

Every day, we use our experience, agility, and innovative research strategies to help get your drug
to market faster—so your treatments can touch the lives of family, friends, and people in need
around the world.

## What We Do

Celerion accelerates drug development through world-class early-phase clinical research and advanced
bioanalysis services. We conduct early-phase clinical studies and provide bioanalytical support
across all stages of development, from preclinical through late-stage clinical. Our clinical and
bioanalytical teams draw on deep global expertise to deliver fast, reliable data and insights that
support confident decision-making.

[Learn More][139]

## Early Phase Clinical Services

### Delivering Early Phase Confidence Through Expertise and Experience

With 50+ years of experience and more than 650 beds worldwide, we offer the largest global network
of early phase operations in the industry. Find out how our expertise, facilities, and full range of
clinical research services prepare us to address the unique needs of your product’s early phase
development.

For over 40 years, Celerion’s bioanalytical laboratories have provided end-to-end support for drug

## Adaptive radiotherapy, a new standard of care

For more than 50 years, Elekta has advanced precision in cancer care. Adaptive radiotherapy is the
next standard of care, combining integrated imaging, planning and treatment workflows to respond to
changes in patient anatomy throughout treatment. From MR-guided and CT-guided workflows to adaptive
radiosurgery and brachytherapy, Elekta helps clinicians deliver more precise and personalized
treatment across a growing range of indications.

[Get ahead of the changes]

### Head and neck cancer

Around 75% of patients with head and neck cancer benefit from radiotherapy during the course of
their disease, making access to precision treatment critical.

[Read more][226]
[15 to 5 no compromise]

### Breast cancer

Every breast cancer case presents its own challenges, from daily anatomical changes to protecting
the heart and lungs. Radiotherapy plays a vital role across all stages of breast cancer.

[Read more][227]
[Motion managed]

### Kidney cancer

For patients who cannot have surgery, radiotherapy provides a non-invasive option with curative
potential that helps preserve kidney function and reduce dose to the bowel and liver.

[Read more][228]
[It's a no brainer]

### Brain tumors

Protect cognition, memory, and vision in brain tumor treatment. Evidence shows how imaging and
adaptive precision help preserve function and quality of life.

[Read more][229]
[Less is more, prostate in two fractions]

### Prostate cancer

Shorter courses, greater precision, preserved function. Clinical evidence shows how daily adaptation
improves accuracy and long-term outcomes.

[Discover more][230]
[Survival rate up, side effects down]

### Gynecological cancers

Treating gynecological cancers requires precision and care. Image-guided radiotherapy and
brachytherapy adapt to pelvic changes while protecting healthy tissue.

[Learn more][231]
[Precision that changes the odds]

### Pancreatic cancer

Evidence shows how adaptive radiotherapy can deliver high-dose treatment safely and extend survival,
offering new hope in one of the hardest cancers to treat.

[Explore the research][232]

## Setting the standard of care, together

From small changes in a tumor to complex clinical decisions, Elekta helps clinicians respond with
precision and confidence, advancing the standard of care in radiotherapy.

# Nobody does
# adaptive
# like **Elekta**

Adaptive radiotherapy is changing what’s possible in cancer treatment.

Elekta is making it work in routine clinical practice, combining precision, workflow and evidence to
help centers deliver adaptive care as a new standard.

[Adaptive Radiotherapy][225]

Your browser does not support HTML video..

## Adaptive radiotherapy, a new standard of care

For more than 50 years, Elekta has advanced precision in cancer care. Adaptive radiotherapy is the
next standard of care, combining integrated imaging, planning and treatment workflows to respond to
changes in patient anatomy throughout treatment. From MR-guided and CT-guided workflows to adaptive
radiosurgery and brachytherapy, Elekta helps clinicians deliver more precise and personalized
treatment across a growing range of indications.

[Get ahead of the changes]

### Head and neck cancer

Around 75% of patients with head and neck cancer benefit from radiotherapy during the course of
their disease, making access to precision treatment critical.

[Read more][226]
[15 to 5 no compromise]

### Breast cancer

Every breast cancer case presents its own challenges, from daily anatomical changes to protecting
the heart and lungs. Radiotherapy plays a vital role across all stages of breast cancer.

[Read more][227]
[Motion managed]

### Kidney cancer

For patients who cannot have surgery, radiotherapy provides a non-invasive option with curative
potential that helps preserve kidney function and reduce dose to the bowel and liver.

[Read more][228]
[It's a no brainer]

### Brain tumors

Protect cognition, memory, and vision in brain tumor treatment. Evidence shows how imaging and
adaptive precision help preserve function and quality of life.

[Read more][229]
[Less is more, prostate in two fractions]

### Prostate cancer

Shorter courses, greater precision, preserved function. Clinical evidence shows how daily adaptation
improves accuracy and long-term outcomes.

[Discover more][230]
[Survival rate up, side effects down]

### Gynecological cancers

Treating gynecological cancers requires precision and care. Image-guided radiotherapy and
brachytherapy adapt to pelvic changes while protecting healthy tissue.

[Learn more][231]
[Precision that changes the odds]

### Pancreatic cancer

Evidence shows how adaptive radiotherapy can deliver high-dose treatment safely and extend survival,
offering new hope in one of the hardest cancers to treat.

[Explore the research][232]

## Setting the standard of care, together

From small changes in a tumor to complex clinical decisions, Elekta helps clinicians respond with
precision and confidence, advancing the standard of care in radiotherapy.

# Advancing Health Outcomes for All®

[ Discover McKesson ][125]

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Business Solutions
 

## Our Areas of Focus

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

We’re reimagining what’s possible by accelerating clinical trials, helping patients start and stay
on therapy, and building a stronger, smarter supply chain for the future.

[ Learn More ][126]
[Person in a blue McKesson-branded jacket with arms crossed, standing in an industrial or warehouse
setting.]

[Two scientists in a laboratory, one standing and reading a tablet, the other sitting and working at

### [ Biopharma Capabilities ][130]

[A person in a yellow shirt and gray cardigan holds a smartphone and a pill bottle, with a child in
the background.]

### [ Prescription Benefit Solutions ][131]

[Person sitting on the floor in a living room, wrapping a bandage around their elbow. A yellow
ottoman and a glass of water are in the background.]

### [ Consumer Products & Services ][132]

[Worker pulls pallet jack quickly through a warehouse aisle, shelves lined with boxes, motion blur
emphasizing fast movement.]
Strengthening Healthcare
 

## Powering Care Locally

For nearly two centuries, McKesson has strengthened the systems that move care forward by supporting
providers, enabling access to medicines and therapies, and removing barriers across the patient
journey.

## Making Healthcare Happen

McKesson Corporation is a U.S.-based company with approximately 43,000 employees worldwide and
facilities across the U.S. and Canada. We serve as the logistical and operational backbone of the
U.S. healthcare system, helping ensure patients can access the therapies and care they need when and
where they need them.

Our services and technology ensure medicines reach every care setting, bring cancer and specialty
care close to home, and help patients break through access and affordability barriers.

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.

# Groundbreaking healthcare technology solutions for the most complex and challenging conditions.
# Inspiring hope and new possibility in people all over the world.

[ See how ][175]

HEALTHCARE TECHNOLOGY

## Medtronic Engineering & Innovation Center (MEIC)

MEIC symbolizes Medtronic’s commitment to R&D and innovation in healthcare. It serves as a
technology hub to deliver on our mission.

[ Learn more ][176]

PUT PATIENTS FIRST

## See the signs, seize your destiny.

The #TimetoDecideDestiny campaign aims to create awareness about the importance of stroke prevention
and timely treatment by reaching the nearest stroke-ready hospital.

[ Learn more ][177]

PATIENT EQUITY

## Decode your rhythm

Learn about bradycardia and leadless pacemaker therapy. Explore causes, symptoms, and care tips.
#DecodeYourRhythm

[ Learn more ][178]

HealthCare Technology

## Medtronic Global Diabetes Capability Center

Engineering technology that simplifies diabetes care

[ Learn more ][179]

## Creating connections to optimize healthcare systems

Innovation without collaboration isn't enough. We work closely with healthcare professionals to
introduce new therapies and optimize treatments.

[ Read more ][180]

Our impact

## Impact with purpose

#### With 95,000-plus people in over 150 countries, we see extraordinary possibilities to further
#### increase our positive impact in the world. We are committed to accelerating access to
#### healthcare technology, advancing inclusion, diversity & equity, and protecting our planet.

[ Learn more ][181]

## Join the team that powers the extraordinary

Want to do work that has the potential to make the world a better place? Then join us. Speed and
decisiveness run through our DNA. Diverse perspectives inspire bold solutions to the world’s most
complex and challenging conditions. Our careers change lives.

### Why Choose Aditya Birla Memorial Hospital

hospital in Pimpri Pune our 500-bed, NABH-accredited facility brings together some of Pune's finest
specialists, ensuring exceptional care for all your health needs. Unlike other hospitals in

## Advance Complex CGT Programs from RUO to GMP

Discovery Life Sciences (Discovery) specializes in donor management and custom prospective
collections of human-derived hematological tissues, serving across the cell and gene therapy (CGT)
development continuum. Our AllCells^{®} GMP and RUO products and services support global life
science researchers and bio-manufacturing organizations in developing complex therapies and
overcoming supply chain bottlenecks.

## AllCells^{®} RUO Products

cells

development continuum. Our AllCells^{®} GMP and RUO products and services support global life

overcoming supply chain bottlenecks.

### Anadolu Medical Center Hospital

**At Anadolu Medical Center Hospital**, we bring our patients not only from Turkey but also from
around the world together with **“Trust”** and **“Comfort.”** With our team of experienced
specialists and advanced technological infrastructure, **we always prioritize your health.**

Our commitment to quality, **supported by international accreditations**, is a testament to the
meticulous and high-standard care we deliver at all times. We are dedicated to providing an
**accurate, transparent, and patient-centered experience** throughout every stage of your treatment
journey.

As a reference center in the field of oncology, Anadolu Medical Center serves as one of Turkey's
leading healthcare institutions, especially in bone marrow transplant treatment.

### PET-CT

PET/CT, PET (Positron Emission Tomography) and CT (Computed Tomography) techniques combining in the
same device is an imaging method that provides more information than they give them separately.

### Hybrid Operating Room

"Hybrid operating room" refers to a new concept of operating rooms where advanced medical imaging
systems and medical devices can be used simultaneously.

### CyberKnife M6

Eliminate tumor surgically lifting up a certain limit, it is a system that prevents the harm of

#### Tumor Boards

Anadolu Medical Center is one of the few healthcare institutions where a multidisciplinary treatment
approach in oncology can be applied under one roof. At our center, the latest developments in cancer
diagnosis and treatment are closely monitored. The Tumor Council consists of pathologists,
radiologists, nuclear medicine specialists, medical oncologists, radiation oncologists, surgical
units, internal medicine units, and doctors who provide medical coordination for international
patients. Treatment is initiated once a plan is decided upon and accepted by the patient. Throughout
the entire treatment process, the "Tumor Council" meets regularly to discuss the patient's response
to treatment and medical follow-up.

### PET-CT

PET/CT, PET (Positron Emission Tomography) and CT (Computed Tomography) techniques combining in the
same device is an imaging method that provides more information than they give them separately.

[ Detay ][151]

### Hybrid Operating Room

systems and medical devices can be used simultaneously.

[ Detay ][152]
[CyberKnife M6]

### CyberKnife M6

Eliminate tumor surgically lifting up a certain limit, it is a system that prevents the harm of
radiation to normal tissues.

[ Detay ][153]

#### Tumor Boards

Anadolu Medical Center is one of the few healthcare institutions where a multidisciplinary treatment
approach in oncology can be applied under one roof. At our center, the latest developments in cancer
diagnosis and treatment are closely monitored. The Tumor Council consists of pathologists,
radiologists, nuclear medicine specialists, medical oncologists, radiation oncologists, surgical
units, internal medicine units, and doctors who provide medical coordination for international
patients. Treatment is initiated once a plan is decided upon and accepted by the patient. Throughout
the entire treatment process, the "Tumor Council" meets regularly to discuss the patient's response
to treatment and medical follow-up.

service.

BVMF’S Bharati Hospital is situated on the main Pune – Satara Road in the southern part of Pune

The hospital not only functions for clinical training of undergraduate and postgraduate students but
also caters to the medical needs of a large segment of population of South Pune as well as the

# ABOUT US

Healthcare is the most important aspect of life, and the pandemic has made this true more than ever.
At Bharati Vidyapeeth Health Sciences, our exceptional team of doctors, nurses and caregivers come
together to bring you excellent care with the latest technologies, best medicine, and warmest
service.

BVMF’S Bharati Hospital is situated on the main Pune – Satara Road in the southern part of Pune
city. The teaching hospital occupies 25 acres of land on a sprawling lush green campus.

The hospital not only functions for clinical training of undergraduate and postgraduate students but
also caters to the medical needs of a large segment of population of South Pune as well as the
surrounding rural areas including poor and needy patients.

## Welcome to the Blood & Marrow Transplant Clinical Trials Network (BMT CTN) 

#### Improving therapies. Saving lives.

## Our Mission

##### Evaluate promising therapeutic approaches in multi-institutional clinical trials to improve
##### the outcomes of blood and bone marrow transplantation and other cellular therapies for
##### patients facing life-threatening blood disorders.

### BMT CTN by the Numbers
* 145+
* Sites

 
* 65+
* Clinical Studies 
  Launched

 
* 17,300+
* Patients 
  Enrolled

 
* 605,000+
* Research 
  Sample 
  Repository

 
* 200+
* Papers 
  Published

Updates made on November 19, 2025

### BMT CTN at a Glance
* Investigators or Research Staff...
* Conducts paradigm changing research addressing important issues in transplantation and cellular
  therapy
* >50 studies opened at >150 transplant centers in 39 US states since inception in 2001
* Opportunities for investigators at all levels
* Patients or Caregivers...
* Improves care and outcomes for patients needing transplantation and other cellular therapies
* Conducts studies to evolve treatment options for patients with a wide variety of diseases
* Provides access to clinical research studies for patients at centers across the US
* Partners...
* Led by global experts in transplantation and cellular therapy who work together to achieve common
  goals
* Proven track record in protocol development, accrual and results dissemination
* Network includes the largest US transplant and cell therapy centers

**Number of Patients Enrolled on BMT CTN Studies **


[[Follow]][36]

The BMT CTN is funded by the National Heart, Lung, and Blood Institute (NHLBI) and the National
Cancer Institute (NCI), both parts of NIH (National Institutes of Health) with grants to:  
Data and Coordinating Center: (U24HL138660), and to the Core and Consortia Sites: UG1HL069246,
UG1HL069249, UG1HL069254, UG1HL069274, UG1HL069278, UG1HL069286, UG1HL069290, UG1HL069291,

UG1HL109322, UG1HL109526, UG1HL138641 and UG1HL138645

(CIBMTR)][10] or the [European Group for Blood and Marrow Transplantation (EBMT)][11].

BMTPlus provides professional development tools, core competency assessments and monitoring as well
as medical error management.

### Outcome Analysis



### Flagging and Alerts

### Policy Zone

### e-Portfolio

#### Clinical Management

### Enrolment

Enables capturing enrolment data, general medical evaluation, disease-specific summary, notes,
socio-economic profile etc.

### Selection

Tracks the process of identifying and screening potential donors.

### Preparation

Enables and tracks the process of scheduling, conditioning and preparing patient for transplant.

### Transplant

Daily clinical forms allow monitoring through pre and post-transplant phases including vital signs,
lab reports, transfusions, medications, complications, nursing notes, as well as, consultant's
notes.

A clinical form with tabular display of essential daily parameters (weight, maximal temperature,
blood counts, liver and renal function tests) to be monitored during the critical phase of BMT
enabled at-a-glance clinical assessment.

The system also offers charts plotting height and weight z-scores based on 'The WHO Child Growth
Standards', which is very relevant for both pre-transplant and follow up assessments.

Enables consultants and other professionals, including multidisciplinary experts who may not be
available locally, from various collaborating centers to share knowledge and provide general as well
as patient-specific advice.

×

#### Outcome Analysis

Real-time outcome analysis based upon customizable study categories, risk categories, treatment
regimes, disease and complications. Comparative survival curves are generated automatically.

The system facilitates submission of transplant data to international registries and scientific
societies, e.g. the Center for International Blood and Marrow Transplant Research (CIBMTR) or the
European Blood and Marrow Transplant group (EBMT)


×

#### Flagging and Alerts

* Generates statuses related to relevant parameters such as lack of critical pre-BMT tests,
  requirement for an evaluation within a defined time from BMT or relevant alerts, e.g. allergies,
  hepatitis or HIV positivity.
* The system warns of any critical enrolment data missing, tracks BMT preparation status, monitors
  post-transplant critical parameters and highlights any abnormalities including missed labs.
* Follow-up height and weight according to standard growth curves is monitored.
* Each time there is a change the concerned individuals are immediately notified by email.
* Periodic emails are sent to the concerned individuals indicating the status of the patient on all
  parameters that need attention.

×

#### Networking

The platform can operate in a stand-alone or a multi center mode.

Multi-center mode allows for usage of common protocols, procedures, quality management systems, and
review of clinical results and regular interaction.

Allows for involvement of remote professionals for consultation and monitoring.

[Learn More][31] ## Patient Navigators Patient Navigators are here to help guide and support patients, survivors, and families through their cancer or transplant journey. We help with referrals to medical specialists, and financial and support resources. [Learn More][32] ## Housing Through grants, private funding and corporate support, we offer temporary Airbnb accommodations to patients in need of life-saving treatments. This program enables patients and families to travel to the best cancer centers without worrying about the cost of lodging. [Learn More][33] ## Metabolic Nutrition Counseling Metabolic Nutrition Counseling provides personalized nutritional support for cancer patients and survivors, focusing on metabolic and gut health and how nutrition supports overall well-being. Sessions are held over Zoom with a certified oncology nutritionist, one-on-one or in small groups. [Learn More][34] ## Medication Co-Pay Assistance Program Financial barriers shouldn't interrupt cancer treatment. Through our partnership with Walgreens Specialty Pharmacy, eligible patients can access co-payment assistance for select oncology medications. leading nonprofit medical society representing invasive and interventional cardiology.

[Keep Reading][101]

Monthly. Explore the specialists and compassionate providers delivering outstanding care across
Rhode Island and Southeastern Massachusetts.

procedure, performed by Sadip, Pant, MD, marking a major step forward for treating patients with
uncontrolled hypertension.

[Learn More][103]

## Our purpose is you.

At CHRISTUS Health, helping you enjoy your best health is more than just a goal. It’s our purpose.
It’s something each of us commits ourselves to every day. Every program, service and treatment we
provide is focused on elevating the health of all those who come to us – body, mind and spirit.

## Care Where and When You Need It
* [
  
  #### Primary Care
  
  Find a provider who will become your partner in better health, offering preventive care, guidance
  and treatment.
  ][114]
* [
  
  #### Urgent Care
  
  Get immediate attention for medical conditions that don’t require a hospital emergency room. Save
  time, check-in online.
  ][115]
* [
  
  #### Virtual Care On Demand
  
  Schedule a video or telephone visit with a caring provider from just about anywhere you are. 
  ][116]

## Become One of the Faces of CHRISTUS

Join a team that extends the healing ministry of Jesus Christ and creates innovative health and
wellness solutions for individuals and communities. Join a company that values dignity, integrity
and compassion, and where you can grow and deliver quality health care.

[Hispanic woman in a suit with mid-length brunette hair smiling at the camera. ]
Associates

At CHRISTUS Health we value you, for you. We know the work you do will make a difference. Join our
family of caregivers, build your career at CHRISTUS and you’ll develop meaningful relationships
while you positively impact lives in our communities.

[ Become a CHRISTUS Associate ][117]
[Happy CHRISTUS nurse smiling into the camera with maroon scrubs on]
Nursing

Nurses are the heart of the CHRISTUS Health family. Whether you are a seasoned nurse, or a new grad,
you will find a wealth of opportunity at CHRISTUS. We care for our nurses – providing excellent
benefits, educational opportunities, shift differentials, clinical ladder programs and more -- so
our nurses can focus on care for our patients. The perfect nursing position is waiting for you.

[ Become a CHRISTUS Nurse ][118]
[Smiling Doctor with stethoscoope]
Physicians

We serve our communities by providing a complete healing experience. Above all, we are committed to
caring for the whole person – mind, body and spirit, because we understand that caring for our
patients goes beyond their physical needs. Become a CHRISTUS physician and find more than a job,
find a calling to serve patients, their families and all our communities with dignity and
compassion.

[ Become A CHRISTUS Physician ][119]

## Our CHRISTUS

[ ][120]
[ ][121]

## CHRISTUS Health at a Glance
* The CHRISTUS Family More than 45,000 dedicated team members—including 15,000 clinicians—provide
  personalized care to our neighbors across the globe. [Community Involvement][122]
* Our Communities Across each of the communities we serve, CHRISTUS Health continues to expand our
  locations to provide more options for exceptional care. [Search Locations][123]
* Our Care We are constantly working to enhance and expand our services by adopting the best
  practices in every aspect of preventative care and treatment. [Learn About the Services &
  Conditions We Treat][124]

[A preschool age girl holds her stuffed animal toy as she talks with a female pediatrician during a
well visit.]

## CHRISTUS Health Plan

Find the right plan for your life and enroll today with CHRISTUS Health Plan.

[ Individual & Family Plans ][125]
[ Medicare Advantage Plans ][126]
[ US Family Health Plan ][127]

## Your Health Hub

[ [A newborn baby takes a bottle from mom]

Your Newborn Feeding Guide

Wondering how often your newborn should eat, what hunger cues look like, or whether those
post-feeding hiccups are normal? This newborn feeding guide answers common questions about
breastfeeding, bottle-feeding, formula feeding and newborn feeding schedules so you can feel more
confident during feeding time.

][128]

Simple answers to questions about your health and care.

[

What Support Really Feels Like as an IMC Nurse

Discover how IMC nurses at CHRISTUS Health in San Marcos find support, teamwork and career growth
while caring for patients with complex medical needs.

][129] [

Essential Wellness Tips for New Moms

Discover essential strategies to support your physical, emotional, and mental health as a new
mother.

][130] [

How to Create Your Birth Plan

While there are no guarantees, a birth plan is a helpful tool to help you communicate your
preferences and expectations for labor and delivery with your health care team. Here's how to create
yours personalized birth plan.

][131] [

CHRISTUS Health in Alamogordo Earns ‘A’ for Patient Safety

Learn how CHRISTUS Hospital earned an ‘A’ safety grade through continuous improvements, better
communication, and advanced ICU telehealth care.

][132]

nation’s top performers for heart attack care][135]
CHRISTUS Heart and Vascular Institute in Longview has been recognized with the Platinum Performance
Achievement Award from the American College of Cardiology's NCDR Chest Pain – MI Registry.
[ [Northwestern State University (NSU) Cenla campus nurses in training] ][136] [CHRISTUS Health
grows cohort programs for Central Louisiana healthcare students][137]
In an effort to strengthen the local healthcare workforce and create new opportunities for aspiring
clinicians, CHRISTUS Health is expanding its tuition-free cohort program.
[ [CH SETX Jasper Memorial Stroke Award] ][138] [CHRISTUS Health receives national award for
comprehensive stroke care][139]
CHRISTUS Health has earned national recognition from the American Heart Association and American
Stroke Association for its commitment to providing high-quality stroke care in Southeast Texas.
[ [Kurt DeVaney] ][140] [CHRISTUS Health Names Kurt DeVaney President of CHRISTUS Health Mount
Pleasant][141]
CHRISTUS Health has named Kurt DeVaney president of CHRISTUS Health Mount Pleasant. DeVaney brings
extensive healthcare leadership experience and a focus on expanding access to high-quality care
across Titus County and East Texas.
[ [DiVinci 5] ][142] [From awareness to action: CHRISTUS Health encourages knowing hernia

CHRISTUS Health is raising awareness about the prevalence of hernias, their symptoms and the
advanced treatment options now available to patients in Southeast Texas.

patients and visitors][145]
CHRISTUS Health announced today the installation of a new weapons detection system designed to

CHRISTUS Health welcomed community members and media to CHRISTUS Ochsner Lake Area Hospital for an

babies across Southwest Louisiana.

## Become a Corporate Member

This program provides corporations access to the most current and comprehensive data on blood and
bone marrow transplantation and an opportunity to participate in CIBMTR annual meetings. The annual
memberships provide support for CIBMTR research, which has helped to make tremendous advances in the
outcomes of transplantation.

[Corporate Membership Options][72]

## Work With Us

CIBMTR is dedicated to improving survival, treatment, and quality of life for patients. With more
than 1,900 publications, CIBMTR conducts practice-changing research that helps patients and
physicians.

[Our Data Photo]

### Our Data

CIBMTR's Outcomes Database contains cellular therapy information for recipients and their donors.
CIBMTR collaborates with centers from around the world to collect clinical information from
allogeneic transplants, autologous transplants, and other cellular therapies performed worldwide,
including nearly all allogeneic transplants and approximately 80% of autologous transplants
performed in the US.

[View Recipient & Donor Data][73]

[Our Studies Photo]

### Our Studies

CIBMTR is at the forefront of both observational and prospective research in hematopoietic cell
transplantation (HCT) and other cellular therapies. We provide opportunities for involvement,
resources and data management, and increased visibility for cellular therapy advancements. Anyone
committed to furthering the field of cellular therapy can find meaningful ways to become involved
and ample support for achieving their goals.

[View All Studies][74]

## Resources For Data Managers

Center administrators and data managers play a critical role in advancing cellular therapy through
complete, accurate, and timely data submission to CIBMTR. These efforts are key in supporting
research that has led to increased survival and an enriched quality of life for thousands of
patients.

[Data Collection Forms Icon]

### [Data Collection Forms][75]

In order to ensure the most relevant data are collected, CIBMTR, in collaboration with the worldwide
cellular therapy community, has developed a standard set of data elements to be collected for all
transplant and other cellular therapy recipients.

[Resources for Data Managers Photo]

[Manuals & Guides Icon]

### [Manuals & Guides][76]

These reference manuals and guides help data managers learn how to submit data efficiently and
smoothly to CIBMTR.

[Center Membership Icon]

### [Center Membership][77]

CIBMTR membership offers many advantages to centers, most notably the opportunity to join a large
network of physicians and clinical research professionals around the world who share the goal of
advancing the science of cellular therapies.

[Support & Resources Icon]

### [Support & Resources][78]

CIBMTR provides member centers with online tools and resources to communicate with us and securely
exchange data.


## CIBMTR's Impact

CIBMTR provides a unique resource of information and expertise to the medical and scientific
community. Now with data from more than 750,000 patients, more than 2,000 publications, and 195
ongoing studies and clinical trials, CIBMTR is at the forefront of research to increase access to
cellular therapies and to improve outcomes.

[Our Impact][79]

# Our Legacy, Our Mission

RECOGNIZED LEADERS IN PERSONALIZED TREATMENTS

[ Request your appointment ][64]

City of Hope^{®}, one of the largest and most advanced cancer research and treatment organizations
in the United States, with a 100+ year legacy, was recognized as one of the nation’s top hospitals
for cancer care, according to U.S. News & World Report’s 2025-26 rankings. 

We bring breakthroughs from the laboratory to our patients with lifesaving speed – treating cancer
with leading-edge technologies, innovative treatments and expert care personalized to each patient’s
needs. 

And we treat patients across the United States through our national footprint of cancer centers.

# Expert Cancer Care:
# Our Legacy, Our Mission

RECOGNIZED LEADERS IN PERSONALIZED TREATMENTS

[ Request your appointment ][64]

City of Hope^{®}, one of the largest and most advanced cancer research and treatment organizations
in the United States, with a 100+ year legacy, was recognized as one of the nation’s top hospitals
for cancer care, according to U.S. News & World Report’s 2025-26 rankings. 

We bring breakthroughs from the laboratory to our patients with lifesaving speed – treating cancer
with leading-edge technologies, innovative treatments and expert care personalized to each patient’s
needs. 

And we treat patients across the United States through our national footprint of cancer centers.
Learn about our cancer centers by exploring the links below.

patients across the country and world.

Continental Hospitals is founded and established with a vision to a focus on healing and a
commitment to well-being of a patient.

Delivering an exceptional patient experience is both a clinical and a business imperative in today’s
healthcare environment. And to do it consistently is not easy. It requires leadership diligence,
engaged employees and physicians, standard practices, and a strong culture committed to always
placing the patient and family at the center of the conversation

### About CP Axtra

CP Axtra Public limited company is Thailand’s largest cash and carry operator, in business since
1988 under the brand name “Makro”, operating through 144 stores, employing over 15,000 people and
catering to over 3 million registered members in the country. The company follows a customer-centric
strategy with a focus on product development. Customers get access to the best prices, along with
unmatched quality and hygiene, owing to Makro’s emphasis on controlling end-to-end processes. With
multiple store formats like Makro Classic stores (for small retailers), Makro Food Service stores
(for HoReCa), Siam Frozen (for frozen food needs) and Siam Food service (for premium food products),
the organisation caters to the diverse needs of its business customers and continuously work towards
always upholding their motto of being ‘Your Trusted Partner’.

to register as a blood stem cell donor.

If you have previously registered with DKMS or another donor center, there is no need to do so
again, as you will already be available for searches worldwide. If you have been diagnosed with any
chronic or serious illnesses (whether current or in the past), please [check with us][57] before
signing up.

The National Marrow Donor Program has established medical guidelines that we follow to protect the
safety of the donor. The following medical conditions would prevent a person from registering as a
donor or from being cleared to donate.
* HIV
* History of heart surgery or heart disease
* Autoimmune disorders such as lupus, rheumatoid arthritis or multiple sclerosis
* Fibromyalgia
* Factor V
* Sleep apnea, breathing problems or severe asthma (daily inhalers are acceptable)
* Diabetes requiring insulin or injectable medication
* Hepatitis B or C
* Kidney or liver disease
* History of stroke, including TIA
* Multiple concussions or head injuries
* Chronic or severe neck or back problems
* Epilepsy or other seizure within one year
* History of blood clotting or bleeding disorders
* Personal history of cancer (exceptions: Stage 0 or in situ melanoma, breast, bladder, cervical and
  cured localized skin cancer such as basal cell or squamous cell carcinoma)



How are patients matched with donors?

A cheek cell sample is collected at registration. The sample is tested for the [HLA
characteristics][58] and added to the global donor pool. Doctors can then search the registry and
find a matching donor for their patient by comparing the patient's HLA to the donor's.

How does a bone marrow or blood stem cell donation work?

**Peripheral stem cell donation**

In about 80 percent of the cases the stem cells are taken from the bloodstream. The donor is
administered the growth factor G-CSF for five days. This drug increases the number of stem cells in
the peripheral blood, which are then obtained directly from the blood using a special procedure. The
donation takes 4-8 hours on one or two consecutive days. No surgery is necessary, you can usually
leave the clinic the same day. This procedure has been used at DKMS since 1996. During the
administration of the drug, flu-like symptoms may occur. Long-term side effects are not known
according to the current state of research.

**Bone marrow donation**

In this method, bone marrow is taken from the donor under general anaesthesia using a special
syringe from the iliac crest. Two small incisions in the area of the rear pelvic bone are usually
sufficient. The resulting wounds are so small that they only require a few stitches or often no
stitches at all and heal quickly. The removal is performed in the prone position and takes about 60
minutes. With bone marrow donation, the risk is essentially limited to the anesthetic. About 5
percent of the bone marrow is taken from the iliac crest. Usually, the donor's bone marrow
regenerates completely within 2 to 4 weeks. Local wound pain can occur, similar to a contusion. Only
in rare cases can there be pain that lasts longer. The stay in the hospital lasts three days in
total. In most cases, as a precautionary measure, a sick note is taken for a few days.

The type of withdrawal depends on the health condition of the patient. A donor should be prepared to
use both methods.

the peripheral blood, which are then obtained directly from the blood using a special procedure. The
donation takes 4-8 hours on one or two consecutive days. No surgery is necessary, you can usually
leave the clinic the same day. This procedure has been used at DKMS since 1996. During the
administration of the drug, flu-like symptoms may occur. Long-term side effects are not known
according to the current state of research.

**Bone marrow donation**

In this method, bone marrow is taken from the donor under general anaesthesia using a special
syringe from the iliac crest. Two small incisions in the area of the rear pelvic bone are usually
sufficient. The resulting wounds are so small that they only require a few stitches or often no
stitches at all and heal quickly. The removal is performed in the prone position and takes about 60
minutes. With bone marrow donation, the risk is essentially limited to the anesthetic. About 5
percent of the bone marrow is taken from the iliac crest. Usually, the donor's bone marrow
regenerates completely within 2 to 4 weeks. Local wound pain can occur, similar to a contusion. Only
in rare cases can there be pain that lasts longer. The stay in the hospital lasts three days in
total. In most cases, as a precautionary measure, a sick note is taken for a few days.

The type of withdrawal depends on the health condition of the patient. A donor should be prepared to
use both methods.

## Bookimed patient stories

Bookimed Milestones
2014
On February 16, 2014, our founding fathers, Yevhenii Kozlov and Ievgen Khotianov, registered
Bookimed. Soon, they set to work with 5 employees to help cancer patients from CIS find hope for
cure abroad.
2015
We strategically decided to employ only medically trained staff for consulting our patients.
Partners from Germany and Turkey join the platform. First 10,000 requests.
2016
A whole new direction to a company — with a support for English-speaking patients, USA and UK-based
in particular. The team counts 87 people.
2017
Raising $500,000 in funding from AVentures Capital, a leading investment fund in Ukraine. That helps
us complement our strengths and grow our potential. Over 35,500 requests.
2018
Now, how to become even better and helpful? What if we give the most objective data to people but
keep our human support? So we’ve created a new algorithm for clinics ranking, and that’s a way new
chapter in our story.
2019
Following the booming plastic surgery trend, we open a new way to deliver our services. A new
dedicated team. New plastic surgery centers across the globe. The team of 130 people.
2020
Bookimed vs. COVID-19: 3 months of the entire world’s lockdown. The team of 40 people flexes the
muscles and delivers patients to the hospitals no matter what. First 500,000 requests.
2021
We’re scaling quickly and penetrating a market segment in Mexico, Dominican Republic, Costa Rica. We
offer partner clinics new pathways for acting upon patient needs with a new cabinet and app. Over
800,000 requests totally.
2022
Launching website in Spanish, German, and Ukrainian. Getting TEMOS Certificate as a proof of being a
reliable and high-quality medical tourism provider. Opening new destination as the UK, Colombia,
Ecuador, Serbia, Croatia.
2023
Launched the website in French, improving our accessibility in Francophone areas. Expanded team with
Arabic and Spanish-speaking doctors, enhancing care for patients speaking these languages. Initiated
Wellness Retreats project.
2024
Welcomed 1,000,000 requests from international patients. Launched a referral program and installment
options for patients. Participated in The 20th Encounter November 2024 in Paris, France.

## Bookimed patient stories

Bookimed Milestones
2014
On February 16, 2014, our founding fathers, Yevhenii Kozlov and Ievgen Khotianov, registered
Bookimed. Soon, they set to work with 5 employees to help cancer patients from CIS find hope for
cure abroad.
2015
We strategically decided to employ only medically trained staff for consulting our patients.
Partners from Germany and Turkey join the platform. First 10,000 requests.
2016
A whole new direction to a company — with a support for English-speaking patients, USA and UK-based
in particular. The team counts 87 people.
2017
Raising $500,000 in funding from AVentures Capital, a leading investment fund in Ukraine. That helps
us complement our strengths and grow our potential. Over 35,500 requests.
2018
Now, how to become even better and helpful? What if we give the most objective data to people but
keep our human support? So we’ve created a new algorithm for clinics ranking, and that’s a way new
chapter in our story.
2019
Following the booming plastic surgery trend, we open a new way to deliver our services. A new
dedicated team. New plastic surgery centers across the globe. The team of 130 people.
2020
Bookimed vs. COVID-19: 3 months of the entire world’s lockdown. The team of 40 people flexes the
muscles and delivers patients to the hospitals no matter what. First 500,000 requests.
2021
We’re scaling quickly and penetrating a market segment in Mexico, Dominican Republic, Costa Rica. We
offer partner clinics new pathways for acting upon patient needs with a new cabinet and app. Over
800,000 requests totally.
2022
Launching website in Spanish, German, and Ukrainian. Getting TEMOS Certificate as a proof of being a
reliable and high-quality medical tourism provider. Opening new destination as the UK, Colombia,
Ecuador, Serbia, Croatia.
2023
Launched the website in French, improving our accessibility in Francophone areas. Expanded team with
Arabic and Spanish-speaking doctors, enhancing care for patients speaking these languages. Initiated
Wellness Retreats project.
2024
Welcomed 1,000,000 requests from international patients. Launched a referral program and installment
options for patients. Participated in The 20th Encounter November 2024 in Paris, France.

with expert doctors. Patients trust EdhaCare because we offer the best medical tourism services.

Medical tourism refers to travelling abroad to receive medical treatment, accessing world-class
healthcare at more affordable costs. EdhaCare simplifies this by handling everything from medical
visa invitation letter to post –treatment care, so you can focus entirely on your recovery.

Why should I choose EdhaCare for medical travel? +

## Testimonials

Getting a match puts a whole new perspective on what you’re doing. Most people spend time
volunteering to help others, but when you see a direct impact of your work, like a match being found
for someone who doesn’t have any other chance at survival, it shows you just how much you are
helping people. It shows why this is important, and why you must continue.

Hannah Steinberg
Gift of Life Campus Ambassador, University of South Carolina

Raising needed funds to support Gift of Life, and coordinating swabbing drives to find potential
donors, has become my passion. By recruiting other volunteers, I have had the opportunity to
encourage hundreds of caring people to engage the best parts of themselves in helping Gift of Life
fulfill its life-saving mission.

Gail Oliver
Gift of Life Volunteer since 1991

This is a good deed that anyone would do – anyone of good heart would donate bone marrow. I feel
grateful for the opportunity and pray and hope my recipient has the best possible outcome.

Aleksei K.
Bone Marrow Donor

Donating showed me that I can do more than I thought I was capable of. It’s an incredible feeling to
think I’ve never met my recipient, but that we share so much in common.

Rebekah H.
Stem Cell Donor

As part of an ethnic minority [with Jewish ancestry] my sample helps make the registry more
representative, increasing equitability in our health care system.

Matthew E.
Stem Cell Donor

Receiving the notification that we got a match was an extremely validating experience. It showed me
that the effort we are putting in is really making an impact. I am excited to keep on swabbing and
keep on finding matches!

Noah Streitfeld
Gift of Life Campus Ambassador, University of Central Florida

I think if more people knew that recipients relied on close genetic matches to receive a transplant,
more people would join the registry.

Adin D.
Stem Cell Donor

How could I say no? I never had a second thought. I know someone at the other end is fighting to
survive cancer and needs my help.

Keaton P.
Stem Cell Donor

I want to thank CBRE because it’s very gratifying when you work with a company of 78,000 employees
that they would drill down deep enough to care about one particular employee’s cause. But that isn’t
why they did it, they really bought into how important this cause is.

Stephen B. Siegel
Chairman of Global Brokerage, CBRE

People think about it too much! Go swab, see what happens, maybe you’ll find out you’re a match. Go
with the flow and don’t worry. Twenty minutes to donate bone marrow and you’re done – you’ve saved a
life!

Carl S.
Bone Marrow Donor

It is rare for people of African ancestry to find a match, and especially hard for people of mixed
race. Donating is a wonderful opportunity, this is more of a privilege than anything else. You just
feel very good in about yourself that you are doing something to help somebody, so I encourage
everyone to get on the registry.

Ifunanya N.
Stem Cell Donor

The Mets are proud to be a longstanding corporate partner of 15 years with Gift of Life. When the
donors and recipients meet [on the ball field] the space is immediately filled with gratitude,
compassion and inspiration. We appreciate the work Gift of Life does every day and we look forward
to creating many more memories together.

Juliana Sabra
Manager of Community Engagement and External Affairs, New York Mets

## Testimonials

Getting a match puts a whole new perspective on what you’re doing. Most people spend time
volunteering to help others, but when you see a direct impact of your work, like a match being found
for someone who doesn’t have any other chance at survival, it shows you just how much you are
helping people. It shows why this is important, and why you must continue.

Hannah Steinberg
Gift of Life Campus Ambassador, University of South Carolina

Raising needed funds to support Gift of Life, and coordinating swabbing drives to find potential
donors, has become my passion. By recruiting other volunteers, I have had the opportunity to
encourage hundreds of caring people to engage the best parts of themselves in helping Gift of Life
fulfill its life-saving mission.

Gail Oliver
Gift of Life Volunteer since 1991

This is a good deed that anyone would do – anyone of good heart would donate bone marrow. I feel
grateful for the opportunity and pray and hope my recipient has the best possible outcome.

Aleksei K.
Bone Marrow Donor

Donating showed me that I can do more than I thought I was capable of. It’s an incredible feeling to
think I’ve never met my recipient, but that we share so much in common.

Rebekah H.
Stem Cell Donor

As part of an ethnic minority [with Jewish ancestry] my sample helps make the registry more
representative, increasing equitability in our health care system.

Matthew E.
Stem Cell Donor

Receiving the notification that we got a match was an extremely validating experience. It showed me
that the effort we are putting in is really making an impact. I am excited to keep on swabbing and
keep on finding matches!

Noah Streitfeld
Gift of Life Campus Ambassador, University of Central Florida

I think if more people knew that recipients relied on close genetic matches to receive a transplant,
more people would join the registry.

Adin D.
Stem Cell Donor

How could I say no? I never had a second thought. I know someone at the other end is fighting to
survive cancer and needs my help.

Keaton P.
Stem Cell Donor

I want to thank CBRE because it’s very gratifying when you work with a company of 78,000 employees
that they would drill down deep enough to care about one particular employee’s cause. But that isn’t
why they did it, they really bought into how important this cause is.

Stephen B. Siegel
Chairman of Global Brokerage, CBRE

People think about it too much! Go swab, see what happens, maybe you’ll find out you’re a match. Go
with the flow and don’t worry. Twenty minutes to donate bone marrow and you’re done – you’ve saved a
life!

Carl S.
Bone Marrow Donor

It is rare for people of African ancestry to find a match, and especially hard for people of mixed
race. Donating is a wonderful opportunity, this is more of a privilege than anything else. You just
feel very good in about yourself that you are doing something to help somebody, so I encourage
everyone to get on the registry.

Ifunanya N.
Stem Cell Donor

The Mets are proud to be a longstanding corporate partner of 15 years with Gift of Life. When the
donors and recipients meet [on the ball field] the space is immediately filled with gratitude,
compassion and inspiration. We appreciate the work Gift of Life does every day and we look forward
to creating many more memories together.

Juliana Sabra
Manager of Community Engagement and External Affairs, New York Mets

## About Iswarya Hospital — Chennai's Best Multispeciality Hospital

**Iswarya Hospital** is a **NABH Certified multispeciality hospital** located at **110, Rajiv Gandhi
Salai (OMR), Kottivakkam, Chennai – 600041**. Established as one of the [best hospitals in
Chennai][18], it offers **400+ beds**, **100+ specialist doctors**, and **20+ departments** covering
every major medical discipline — from Cardiology, Oncology, Neurology and Orthopedics to Nephrology,
Gastroenterology, Gynecology, Diabetology and Pediatrics. It is among the few hospitals in **Chennai
offering robotic-assisted surgery**, multi-organ transplantation (kidney, liver, heart), a dedicated
cancer centre with PET-CT & LINAC radiation therapy, and a 24×7 emergency & trauma unit. Trusted by
patients across Tamil Nadu and India, Iswarya provides **cashless treatment through 25+ insurance
partners** and is conveniently accessible from Thiruvanmiyur, Sholinganallur, Adyar, Besant Nagar,
Velachery, Pallikaranai, Perungudi, Karapakkam and all of South Chennai.

## Community Initiatives

Through Jupiter Foundation, we ensure world class health care for the people that are economically
challenged. Jupiter Foundation works on the philosophy of putting the patient first in everything.

[Know more][120]

## Careers

At Jupiter, we believe there is a better path to healing that humanizes the practice of health care
and inspires hope in the Patient & family who need it most. Our primary value – The needs of the
patient come first – is at centre of our plans and decisions. You'll also find that our pride – in
where we work, and in what we do – is a common trait. You will be truly part of an amazing team
committed to solving the most serious and complex medical challenges.

## Why Use Lyfboat?

### **Find the right Hospitals & Doctors**

Researching hospitals and doctors can be time consuming and overwhelming. We simplify the process
for you. Using Lyfboat, you can find hospitals by treatment or location. We provide you with price
estimates, rich imagery, detailed hospital & doctor profiles, and previous patient reviews so you
can easily compare and select the right provider. Our goal is to enable you to make confident
decisions about where to get your treatment.

### **Quick responses**

We understand you are probably anxious to get better soon. Each hospital has dedicated international
travel teams that are available to respond to your queries in hours. They also help with planning
travel logistics such as accommodations, ground transportation, translation and more.

### **Medical Travel Facilitation**

Sometimes we don’t know where to start with the research. You can rely on our quality information
and guidance to assist with picking the right hospital and doctor. We can also assist with all your
medical travel needs. You can get help with booking flights, accommodations, transportation,
translation and more. We want you to focus on getting better.

### **Accredited Hospitals**

Undergoing any kind of procedure can be a bit scary. We hand pick each hospital & only
internationally accredited hospitals are included to ensure you will receive high quality care.

### **24/7 Customer Service**

Rest easy knowing real people are ready to help you 24 hours a day. You can contact us anytime via
website chat, email or telephone.

### **It’s free to use**

Patients can create a free account on Lyfboat and can do independent research for hospitals and
doctors as per their needs. Patients do not pay anything to Lyfboat for using its services.

## Why Use Lyfboat?

### **Find the right Hospitals & Doctors**

Researching hospitals and doctors can be time consuming and overwhelming. We simplify the process
for you. Using Lyfboat, you can find hospitals by treatment or location. We provide you with price
estimates, rich imagery, detailed hospital & doctor profiles, and previous patient reviews so you
can easily compare and select the right provider. Our goal is to enable you to make confident
decisions about where to get your treatment.

### **Quick responses**

We understand you are probably anxious to get better soon. Each hospital has dedicated international
travel teams that are available to respond to your queries in hours. They also help with planning
travel logistics such as accommodations, ground transportation, translation and more.

### **Medical Travel Facilitation**

Sometimes we don’t know where to start with the research. You can rely on our quality information
and guidance to assist with picking the right hospital and doctor. We can also assist with all your
medical travel needs. You can get help with booking flights, accommodations, transportation,
translation and more. We want you to focus on getting better.

### **Accredited Hospitals**

Undergoing any kind of procedure can be a bit scary. We hand pick each hospital & only
internationally accredited hospitals are included to ensure you will receive high quality care.

### **24/7 Customer Service**

Rest easy knowing real people are ready to help you 24 hours a day. You can contact us anytime via
website chat, email or telephone.

### **It’s free to use**

Patients can create a free account on Lyfboat and can do independent research for hospitals and
doctors as per their needs. Patients do not pay anything to Lyfboat for using its services.

#### MedWin Publishers

Medwin is your gateway to a world of scientific and medical insights, striving to make research
accessible to everyone. We are a global, open-access publisher that publishes articles from
researchers worldwide, emphasizing the latest discoveries in various scientific fields. Our
commitment is to share significant works, including case studies and reviews, and create a strong
platform for researchers and readers globally. Medwin aims to contribute to the global intellectual
landscape by providing profound insights into the latest advancements in scientific research. Our
mission is simple: illuminate the latest findings and create a space where researchers from every
corner of the globe can connect and share ideas.

#### About Us

At Medwin, we're on a mission to make science and medicine understandable and available to all. We
publish original articles that showcase the latest discoveries in a variety of fields. Our goal is
to create a platform for researchers worldwide, transcending borders to share knowledge. We're not
just a publisher; we're a bridge connecting research from every part of the world. Our aim is to
bring the best research to light and share it with the global community.

#### Vision

We dream of being a catalyst for scientific knowledge across all fields. Medwin is a team that
believes in unity, working together to simplify communication and optimize research. We're here to
bring top-notch research to the forefront, covering advanced topics in science and engineering
around the world.

#### Aim & Scope

Medwin's main goal is to cover the latest in scientific progress. We want to contribute to knowledge
by promoting quality research. Our mission is to publish excellent, peer-reviewed work in all
emerging fields of science. We're committed to exploring daily research updates, strengthening
scientific knowledge, contributing to research progress, and providing a high-quality online
platform for original research.

#### Objectives
* **Explore Daily Research:** Medwin is dedicated to keeping up with daily developments in the
  scientific field, keeping you informed about the latest breakthroughs.
* **Strengthen Scientific Knowledge:** We aim to make science understandable and exciting for
  everyone, building a community passionate about research.
* **Contribute to Scientific Progress:** Medwin actively contributes to research progress by
  providing a platform for groundbreaking findings.
* **Provide a High-Quality Platform:** Our commitment to quality extends to providing a robust
  online platform for original research, ensuring the knowledge we share is top-notch.

#### Publication Model

Scholarly publishing, regardless of the medium, entails significant expenditures beyond mere content
creation. Publishers contribute value through a range of essential services, including the
production of documents across various formats, editorial and design work, marketing, and the
facilitation of connections between readers and authors. Each of these activities incurs costs.
Consequently, even non-profit publishers must not only recoup these expenses but also generate a
financial reserve to sustain their operations.

In response to the evolving landscape of scientific publishing, which seeks to enhance the
readership, accessibility, and impact of scholarly research, numerous journals are transitioning
from the traditional subscription-based model to an Open Access (OA) paradigm. Within the gold OA
framework, articles are made freely accessible online upon publication, eliminating paywalls.
Instead, the financial responsibility for publication shifts to the authors’ institutions or funding
organizations, which cover the Article Processing Charge (APC) once the manuscript is accepted.

#### MedWin Publishers

Medwin is your gateway to a world of scientific and medical insights, striving to make research
accessible to everyone. We are a global, open-access publisher that publishes articles from
researchers worldwide, emphasizing the latest discoveries in various scientific fields. Our
commitment is to share significant works, including case studies and reviews, and create a strong
platform for researchers and readers globally. Medwin aims to contribute to the global intellectual
landscape by providing profound insights into the latest advancements in scientific research. Our
mission is simple: illuminate the latest findings and create a space where researchers from every
corner of the globe can connect and share ideas.

#### About Us

At Medwin, we're on a mission to make science and medicine understandable and available to all. We
publish original articles that showcase the latest discoveries in a variety of fields. Our goal is
to create a platform for researchers worldwide, transcending borders to share knowledge. We're not
just a publisher; we're a bridge connecting research from every part of the world. Our aim is to
bring the best research to light and share it with the global community.

#### Vision

We dream of being a catalyst for scientific knowledge across all fields. Medwin is a team that
believes in unity, working together to simplify communication and optimize research. We're here to
bring top-notch research to the forefront, covering advanced topics in science and engineering
around the world.

#### Aim & Scope

Medwin's main goal is to cover the latest in scientific progress. We want to contribute to knowledge
by promoting quality research. Our mission is to publish excellent, peer-reviewed work in all
emerging fields of science. We're committed to exploring daily research updates, strengthening
scientific knowledge, contributing to research progress, and providing a high-quality online
platform for original research.

#### Objectives
* **Explore Daily Research:** Medwin is dedicated to keeping up with daily developments in the
  scientific field, keeping you informed about the latest breakthroughs.
* **Strengthen Scientific Knowledge:** We aim to make science understandable and exciting for
  everyone, building a community passionate about research.
* **Contribute to Scientific Progress:** Medwin actively contributes to research progress by
  providing a platform for groundbreaking findings.
* **Provide a High-Quality Platform:** Our commitment to quality extends to providing a robust
  online platform for original research, ensuring the knowledge we share is top-notch.

#### Publication Model

Scholarly publishing, regardless of the medium, entails significant expenditures beyond mere content
creation. Publishers contribute value through a range of essential services, including the
production of documents across various formats, editorial and design work, marketing, and the
facilitation of connections between readers and authors. Each of these activities incurs costs.
Consequently, even non-profit publishers must not only recoup these expenses but also generate a
financial reserve to sustain their operations.

In response to the evolving landscape of scientific publishing, which seeks to enhance the
readership, accessibility, and impact of scholarly research, numerous journals are transitioning
from the traditional subscription-based model to an Open Access (OA) paradigm. Within the gold OA
framework, articles are made freely accessible online upon publication, eliminating paywalls.
Instead, the financial responsibility for publication shifts to the authors’ institutions or funding
organizations, which cover the Article Processing Charge (APC) once the manuscript is accepted.

## MUSC Health named South Carolina’s best hospital for 11th consecutive year.

For the 11th year in a row, U.S. News & World Report has ranked MUSC Health University Medical
Center as the **No. 1 hospital in South Carolina** in its 2025–2026 Best Hospitals rankings. The
recognition highlights the strength of MUSC Health’s powerhouse Obstetrics & Gynecology team, along
with many other specialties rated High Performing for delivering care well above the national
average.

MUSC Health named South Carolina’s best hospital for 11th consecutive year. For the 11th year in a row, U.S. News & World Report has ranked MUSC Health University Medical Center as the **No. 1 hospital in South Carolina** in its 2025–2026 Best Hospitals rankings. The recognition highlights the strength of MUSC Health’s powerhouse Obstetrics & Gynecology team, along with many other specialties rated High Performing for delivering care well above the national average. offers resources that extend beyond health care.

### Meet Levi

Levi was born at 24 weeks and diagnosed with severe bronchopulmonary dysplasia (BPD), a chronic
disease that can occur with underdeveloped lungs. Today, Levi is a smiley, joyful two-year old who’s
reaching milestones and getting stronger every day.

[Read Levi's Story][97] [Share Your Story][98]

offers resources that extend beyond health care.

NewGen Biologics

## Medical Device
## Distributor

Welcome to NewGen! As a trusted medical device company supplying regenerative medicine products, we
are also dedicated to supporting healthcare providers in building their brand and advancing their
practice.

Our headquarters is based in Cleveland, Ohio, and we proudly serve medical offices and clinics
throughout the United States with premium-grade regenerative medicine solutions.

As a leading medical device distributor, we supply top-of-the-line Platelet Rich Plasma (PRP)  kits,
Bone Marrow Concentrate (BMC) devices,  Adipose Concentrating System (Progenikine), and a centrifuge
that has the ability to process all three kits

[A surgeon holding four fat graft syringes.][A surgeon holding four fat graft syringes.]
[PRP centrifuge used in PurePRP® SP PRP kit][PRP centrifuge used in PurePRP® SP PRP kit]

Our products have been proven effective in treating a variety of conditions such as pain management,
orthopedic conditions, erectile dysfunction, facelifts, hair loss, osteoarthritis, and more.

At NewGen, we are committed to staying ahead of the curve by keeping up to date with the latest
advancements in technology. We work closely with our customers to introduce new, safe, and proven
treatments to their practice.

Learn more about our comprehensive range of products and services below and contact us for more
information. Thank you for considering NewGen as your trusted medical device distributor.

[Get pricing
][32]

## Medical Practice Support Services
* ### Training
  
  Proper training is crucial to effectively utilize our innovative products. We offer staff training
  as well as hands-on training programs on a case by case basis to make sure the medical
  practitioners are ready to build their biologics practice. Discover our training options and learn
  how to get started.
  
  [Platelet Rich Plasma Facial Aestetics][Platelet Rich Plasma Facial Aestetics]
* ### Marketing
  
  Our marketing services are tailored to the needs of your medical practice, helping you grow and
  expand your reach. We offer a variety of marketing support including patient education materials,
  social media management, blog writing, and website marketing materials and information. Let us
  help take your practice to the next level!
  
  [PureBMC marketing brochure for regenerative medicine treatment with bone marrow cells][PureBMC
  marketing brochure for regenerative medicine treatment with bone marrow cells]
* ### Research
  
  We understand the importance of advancing biologics research for the betterment of patient
  outcomes. That’s why we offer comprehensive research services to medical practices, providing them
  with cutting-edge data and information related to your field. Learn more about our research
  support services for the evolving market of biologics.
  
  [Osteoarthritis & Ortho-Biologic Therapies brochure showing research in regenerative
  medicine][Osteoarthritis & Ortho-Biologic Therapies brochure showing research in regenerative
  medicine]

[View our support services][33]

## Distributor

Welcome to NewGen! As a trusted medical device company supplying regenerative medicine products, we
are also dedicated to supporting healthcare providers in building their brand and advancing their
practice.

Our headquarters is based in Cleveland, Ohio, and we proudly serve medical offices and clinics
throughout the United States with premium-grade regenerative medicine solutions.

As a leading medical device distributor, we supply top-of-the-line Platelet Rich Plasma (PRP)  kits,
Bone Marrow Concentrate (BMC) devices,  Adipose Concentrating System (Progenikine), and a centrifuge

orthopedic conditions, erectile dysfunction, facelifts, hair loss, osteoarthritis, and more.

advancements in technology. We work closely with our customers to introduce new, safe, and proven
treatments to their practice.

information. Thank you for considering NewGen as your trusted medical device distributor.

# Building a Healthier Future

Our mission is to improve the health, vitality, and longevity of human beings through
bioengineering.

# Platform

## Establishing a New Source for Life-Saving Stem Cells

Ossium has created a new paradigm for cell therapy development by bringing the deceased donor
transplant ecosystem into the fight against diseases of the blood and immune systems.

[View Platform][27]

# Partners

## Let's Work Together

Ossium works closely with healthcare providers, life science companies, and organ procurement
organizations to develop and deploy cell therapies.

[Partner With Us][28]
